```yaml
name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-macos-arm:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Install Homebrew dependencies (if any)
      - name: Install Homebrew packages
        run: |
          # Homebrew is pre-installed on macOS 14, but ensure the shell environment is set
          echo 'eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> $GITHUB_ENV
          eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
          # Install any required system packages (add as needed)
          # brew install <package>

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Create virtual environment
        run: |
          python -m venv .venv
          source .venv/bin/activate
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Run pyinstaller.sh
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          bash pyinstaller.sh

      - name: Zip the app bundle
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          if [ -d "SSHPilot.app" ]; then
            zip -r SSHPilot.app.zip SSHPilot.app
          else
            echo "SSHPilot.app not found – skipping zip"
          fi

      - name: Generate DMG checksum
        run: |
          if [ -f "SSHPilot.dmg" ]; then
            shasum -a 256 SSHPilot.dmg > SSHPilot.sha256
          else
            echo "SSHPilot.dmg not found – skipping checksum"
          fi

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot
          path: |
            SSHPilot.dmg
            SSHPilot.app.zip
            SSHPilot.sha256
```
